verdict.rationale: Operating an online government tax service through natural-language commands is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party natural-language, chat, or agent interface: Webfile sits behind an authenticated eSystems session, and probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs, or OpenAPI spec. The keyless Socrata open-data endpoint is a read-only developer building block, and phone filing for no-sales returns is an adjacent channel; neither earns credit.
